title: Open Air Chicago hourly aggregations (catalog.data.gov link, not reachable from this environment)
summary: A human-supplied link to a US open-data catalogue record titled "Open Air Chicago hour aggregations", described as hourly air-quality sensor data from a US city. The link could not be opened: the host catalog.data.gov is not on the egress allowlist, so no metadata, schema, coverage dates, licence or sample could be read. The source is therefore unverified and its geography (Chicago, US) falls outside the use case's primary geography (IT).
